mapper.sql: p.id, p.name, p.base_url, p.api_key, p.model, p.image_base_url, p.image_api_key, p.image_model, p.is_active, p.created_by, p.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT , u.username AS created_by_name FROM ai_model_provider p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.created_by ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
SELECT , u.username AS created_by_name FROM ai_model_provider p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.created_by WHERE p.created_by = #{createdBy} ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
SELECT , u.username AS created_by_name FROM ai_model_provider p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.created_by WHERE p.id = #{id}
SELECT , u.username AS created_by_name FROM ai_model_provider p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.created_by WHERE p.is_active = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_model_provider (name, base_url, api_key, model, image_base_url, image_api_key, image_model, is_active, created_by, create_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{baseUrl}, #{apiKey}, #{model}, #{imageBaseUrl}, #{imageApiKey}, #{imageModel}, #{isActive}, #{createdBy}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_model_provider SET name = #{name}, base_url = #{baseUrl}, api_key = #{apiKey}, model = #{model}, image_base_url = #{imageBaseUrl}, image_api_key = #{imageApiKey}, image_model = #{imageModel} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_model_provider SET is_active = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
